acceptedLags.name: openssl
acceptedLags.reason: the tree is a telephony node that faces the network for years, so it follows a long-term-support series: OpenSSL's release strategy names 3.5 the LTS series, supported until 2030-04-08; the 4.x releases are not LTS
acceptedLags.reviewWhen: the next OpenSSL LTS series (the release strategy publishes one every April of odd-numbered years)
